Wavelets are a pretty hot topic and have been the subject of a lot of research. What I have attempted to include here is what I hope to be an intuitive and practical understanding of some simpler wavelets for non-mathematicians.

Here you can find a copy of an old paper I wrote on the Haar basis. I was young and naive then, but it still serves to compare the Haar basis with mipmapping fairly effectively.

Also included here is some pretty bare-bones code for performing the Fast Wavelet Transform (FWT) and Inverse Fast Wavelet Transform (IFWT) on Daubechies Wavelets.

There are also some wavelet books and links hidden around here that I have found useful.

Edward Kmett
